item.title: Strobe 1.0.1
item.description:
• The video is a floating panel too: drag it by its title bar, resize it from its corner, and its play bar and zoom buttons go with it.
  • Auto Arrange (Option-Command-A, or the new toolbar button) puts every panel in a recommended place with nothing overlapping, and keeps them tidy as the window changes size until you move one yourself. Where you put them is saved with the project.
  • Tab hides the other panels so the video fills the window, and the Data table spreads out to fill a wide panel.
